u0: No key-related obligation is active yet: the matching key has not been taken while the door was shut, the door is not open, and the overall goal of reaching the designated box still lies ahead. If the agent picks up the key before opening the door, the requirement to open the door becomes pending. If the agent never takes the key, this conditional rule is not violated, but the closed door still blocks access to the box room.
u1: The matching key has been taken while the door was still closed, so opening the door is now required to satisfy the rule. The door remains shut, and if the key has since been dropped, it must be recovered and used before the door can be opened. Once the door has been opened, the key-related requirement is satisfied and the overall mission continues with picking up the designated box.
u2: The door has been opened at least once, so any obligation created by taking the matching key has been fulfilled, and no further key-and-door requirement remains. This satisfaction persists even if the door is later toggled shut. Reaching this stage alone does not mark successful completion; if it has not already happened, the designated box still needs to be picked up to finish the overall mission.
